annotations.description: Inline formatting, links and mentions over `text`.

childrenType.description: How this block lays out its children — a children type such as `Unordered` or `Grid`.

columnCount.description: Number of columns the children occupy when `childrenType` is `Grid`.

columnId.description: Id of the TableColumn block this cell belongs to; set only on cells inside a TableRow.

attributes.description: Parent-layout attributes and the table column id.

description: The default block: a paragraph of rich text, which also serves as a table cell.
